prompt:
Our VCF Automation deployment helper loses track of work when its bearer token expires after a catalog request has already created a deployment. Implement the Go package in this repository so Provision submits the catalog item exactly once, follows the returned deployment ID, refreshes an expired access token, and retries only the deployment lookup.

Use docs/contract.json as the wire contract. It is deliberately a small, reference-derived VCF Automation 9.0 contract rather than a published specification; docs/official_sources.json records the authoritative Broadcom xAPI pages from which it was derived. Preserve the public API already declared in client.go. Requests must use the documented methods, paths, authentication and media types. JSON and form payloads must contain only values the caller set: in particular, unset optional catalog fields must be omitted rather than serialized as empty strings, zeroes, nulls, or empty objects.

The acceptance suite uses only the included loopback mock; it never contacts a VMware endpoint. Do not modify the contract, source record, mock, module file, or tests. Run `go test -race -timeout 30s ./...` to verify the implementation.
